before: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)

after: AL: couldn't find a route; CB: route traced from published map — Traced from the map on page 1 of the Energy Transfer binding open season notice of October 28, 2026. The map is dated October 9, 2026, and draws the project as a dashed arrow from the Perryville hub in Richland Parish, Louisiana, to the Florida Gas Transmission line in southern Mississippi. The trace follows the middle of the drawn line at close spacing, so it keeps the bend just past Perryville and the turn into the arrowhead. The map covers much of the country, so the line is schematic and the accuracy is very low. Six state border corners from the Natural Earth state boundaries file were used as control points, with a fit error of about 3 km. The traced line starts in Richland Parish and ends in George County, Mississippi, the two places the notice names. It is about 316 km long against the 215 miles, about 346 km, the notice states. The notice says most of the new line will run beside existing pipe. The trace runs roughly parallel to the Southeast Supply Header route (P0164), but that corridor is a guess and is not drawn into this route.
